newsitem.title: JAPAN: TOCOM says in touch with London's LPPM on PGM.
newsitem.headline: TOCOM says in touch with London's LPPM on PGM.

text.p: The Tokyo Commodity Exchange (TOCOM) said on Wednesday that it was in touch with the London Platinum and Palladium Market (LPPM) about restoring orderly trading of platinum group metals (PGM).
A senior TOCOM official also told Reuters that the exchange would introduce a limit on positions for nearby platinum futures.
The TOCOM precious metals market committee has already approved the measure, but the date for the change has yet to be decided, the official said.
Under the move, the maximum position that one investor would be able to take would be 600 lots for the spot month. Positions in the next month would be restricted to 1,200 lots, the official said.
Currently, a single investor is allowed to hold 1,200 lots across the board.
